_comment: P1-12 construction calendar profiles. Default stays 7D for backward compatibility with the locked dual-calendar policy (SKILL.md solve rules), but it is no longer silent: every run discloses calendar_basis and recommends 6D for standard commercial fit-out.
recommended_default_reason: 6-day construction week is the standard commercial fit-out organisation; 7x8 works weekends and most statutory holidays, which is aggressive.
default_disclosure: Construction calendar defaults to 7x8 (weekends working, only Spring Festival off). This is aggressive; the recommended standard for commercial fit-out is 6D. Switch with --calendar_profile 6d.

5D.description: Mon-Fri construction, all statutory holidays off.

6D.description: Saturday works, Sunday off; statutory holidays working except Spring Festival.

7D.description: Current locked dual-calendar construction policy; aggressive.

NIGHT_ALLOWED.not_implemented_reason: Night work requires the shift model's explicit night-shift scenario (config/resource_constraints.json shift_model.night_shift.requires_explicit_scenario). Selection is rejected rather than silently approximated by a day calendar profile.
NIGHT_ALLOWED.description: Declares night work permission; enforce via shift model, not this profile.

WEEKEND_ONLY_SPECIAL.not_implemented_reason: Requires the building's occupation/operation restriction details (weekday work windows, noise limits). Not approximated: selection is rejected pending building-specific input.
WEEKEND_ONLY_SPECIAL.description: For occupied buildings where only weekend work is permitted.

CUSTOM.not_implemented_reason: A custom profile needs an explicit user-supplied calendar definition; no default is invented. Selection is rejected until a custom definition format exists.

building_restrictions.none: No building restriction; profile applies as selected.
building_restrictions.no_weekend_work: Landlord/building restriction overrides the profile: weekend construction work is prohibited, forcing the 5D construction mode.
